clarification: The empty real-transaction history is decided directly by the empty-execution rule, before CO enumeration. It has an empty existential witness and costs zero states and zero semantic checks. The per-complete-CO-candidate state rule applies to the nonempty search branch. Initialization alone is not an enumerated real transaction.
basis: The original preregistered empty-history-zero-budget case and existing implementation already agree on this behavior; the general counter sentence omitted its explicit exception.
scope: A clarification of an existing direct proof branch, not a new accepted model range or a change to a measured counter.
